passengerIntro: Most passengers travel on a walk-in basis, though advance booking is available directly at our terminals.

passengerSteps.title: Head to the terminal
passengerSteps.description: Arrive at the port for your route (see our list of ports). Walk-in booking is available and is how most passengers travel with us.

passengerSteps.title: Prefer to book ahead?
passengerSteps.description: Currently, advanced passenger bookings can only be done through 12GO (extra fees may apply). Coming soon: We're partnering with Mercury Transport so you can book and pay online!

cargoIntro: Trucks and cargo shipments follow a separate, advance-payment process.

cargoSteps.title: Message our Cargo Viber Group
cargoSteps.description: Send a message to our official cargo booking Viber group to arrange your shipment.

cargoSteps.title: Send advance payment
cargoSteps.description: Pay via InstaPay or QR PH to secure your booking.

cargoSteps.title: Book your ferry slot
cargoSteps.description: Once payment is confirmed, coordinate with our staff in the Viber group and we'll reserve your slot on the next available cargo sailing, or on your preferred date.

cargoSteps.title: Drop off & timing
cargoSteps.description: Coordinate drop-off at the shipyard/terminal with our staff in the Viber group ahead of the scheduled departure.
